biotools.summary: FlowVision is flow cytometry analysis software for Windows and macOS that runs on your own computer; FCS files are never uploaded. It opens FCS 2.0 to 3.2 files from conventional and spectral cytometers. Suggest gates proposes the main populations on your data, and every gate shows things to check. Every change reports how many numbers moved, with one-click undo. Axes start from the instrument range, with fit to data in one click. Includes compensation, spectral unmixing from single-stain controls, UMAP and FlowSOM clustering, batch analysis with templates, normal ranges, an audit trail, gating import from other programs and Gating-ML 2.0, and a report layout editor. Free 30-day trial; research use only.
